map037/ev002/p0.note: The CH05|CH06 boundary at (16,5). Map040 (Nowtoch) is NOT in SLICE_MAP_IDS, so metadata_wiring.classify_event returned ("skip", "out-of-slice warp") and NO warp_event was emitted -- PassageCave2F has exactly two warps, (16,27) and (16,26), nothing at (16,5). Under the boundary convention (operator, 2026-09-04) B11 therefore asserts only that the player REACHES the boundary; the crossing into Nowtoch belongs to CH06. STEP 7 CONSTRAINT: the beat must approach from the EAST, at=(17,5), via approach_to(..., prefer="east") -- it must NOT step on (16,5), and must NOT use the default approach cell (16,6), because Map040 warps back to Map037 (16,6) twice (05-passage-cave.md 2), so BOTH tiles become live warps the moment CH06 stages map 40. A BFS avoiding both reaches (17,5) in 33 steps. Reaching it requires crossing a staircase (B13/B14). NOT round-trippable, and that is the point: with map 40 unstaged there is no warp to cross and nothing to come back from, so B11 is the one warp row in the chapter that cannot use the round-trip idiom. CH06 writes the round trip when it stages Nowtoch.
